main_measure.name: mean of forecast x excess 2-bar return at 21:00 cases, pooled
main_measure.threshold: t >= +2 to confirm (with top-minus-bottom > 0); t <= -2 to reject

supporting_check.name: top minus bottom forecast tercile, mean excess 2-bar return (Welch t)

decided_by: Confirm rule met: main t = 4.78 >= +2 and top-minus-bottom difference 0.00101 > 0.
reading: Cases are bars whose timestamp + 1h is 21:00 UTC with forecast > 0, first per UTC date per window, return taken positionally close[t+2]/close[t]-1 inside the window; the coin mean uses the non-overlapping 0,2,4,... grid of all its windows; terciles are pooled forecast cut points with bottom <= lower cut and top >= upper cut.
